extract_h36m_training_data_with_smpl: extract Human3.6M training data with SMPL pose and shape parameters and save to NPZ format
extract_h36m_training_data_without_smpl: extract Human3.6M training data from CDF pose files and save 2D and 3D keypoints to NPZ
run_h36m_data_extraction: run the script to load all Human3.6M training sequences with SMPL parameters into an output directory
convert_h36m_joints_to_spin24: convert Human3.6M 17-joint skeleton data to the SPIN 24-joint global ordering format
compute_bbox_from_keypoints: compute bounding box center and scale from 2D keypoint coordinates for image cropping
